articles.title: Quantitative evaluation of single-grating phase-contrast imaging with a femtosecond laser–plasma Kα X-ray source
articles.authors: Georges Giakoumakis, Amelie Ferré, Daria Gudz, Mouad Saliji, Jérôme Primot, Olivier Utéza, Raphaël Clady, Adrien Stolidi
articles.summary: We present the first implementation of an X-ray phase-contrast imaging approach using single 2D-grating phase retrieval and a quasi-monochromatic hard K α X-ray source generated via high-intensity femtosecond laser—plasma interaction. To highlight its pertinence, we demonstrate quantitative phase-contrast measurements of a known canonical physical object, retrieving phase distribution with high-fidelity, under varying experimental conditions. As a marker of such performance, a correlation score of up to 0.922 ± 0.008 is obtained between theoretical and experimental phase images. …

articles.title: A novel optical scanning system for laser machining of vertical sidewall
articles.authors: Jaehee Kim, Dongsik Kim, Hyun Choi, Jeonghong Ha
institutions: Pohang University of Science and Technology
articles.summary: Despite its many advantages, laser micromachining has limitations, such as tapering due to plasma-induced distortion, gaussian beam profiles, and defocusing effects. Although process parameter optimization and adjusting the angle-of-incidence (AOI) have been investigated to reduce tape angle of the sidewall, existing approaches often require complex process optimization, workpiece tilting, or multi-axis scanning systems. In this study, we developed a novel optical scanning system consisting of three spherical lenses and a 2D galvanometer scanner to enable AOI variation using a simplified optical configuration. …
